DEBRIEF
Where she ended: Still at her opening position, having agreed to nothing; she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and to know who made the decision, while the fair outcome is a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, which the meeting never reached.
What moved her: Nothing yet; you showed the two late-night edit times, but without a date or a turned screen she could not check them, so they did not count.
What cost ground: Nothing cost you ground, though you went straight past her opening question about who decided and how Owen found out, which left her main grievance open.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your edit times near midnight were heading toward a late night, which is why she went short and asked for the date, but it proves nothing about the essay and is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: When she opens by asking who decided, own in one sentence that the zero went in before you called her, then turn the screen and give the date along with the edit times.
